SO MUCH MORE THAN STEPS

A dance floor.
A circle of friends.
A place to belong.

Life feels a little lighter when we move together. At Line & Wine, a simple dance becomes a reason to get out, connect, and do something just for you.

From that very first step to the last laugh of the evening, it's about enjoying the moment — and the people beside you.

Come as you are. We'll find our rhythm together. ↗

Small beginnings. Beautiful connections.

SIX PEOPLE. ONE PORCH. SO MUCH POSSIBILITY.

It started with
a little happiness.

After the isolation of COVID-19, Michelle Schmidt invited six people onto her porch to dance. No grand plan. Just a simple idea: bring people together and put a little joy back into everyday life.

Today, that little idea is a flourishing community across Cape Town and KwaZulu-Natal — with Michelle and Alison Jamieson sharing the journey.

Meet the heart behind it↗
